about.appDescription: Smart Windows C: drive cleanup tool
about.portableUpdateHint: Portable builds do not install updates automatically. Download the new zip from the author's channel and replace the current folder; GitHub Releases is the official fallback.
about.updateHint: Updates are hosted on GitHub. DNS issues may affect access in some regions; retry later if needed.
about.nameDescription: Light means lightweight and C refers to the C: drive. LightC helps clean system junk safely and efficiently to free disk space.

layout.pagesDesc: Switch features via side menu, closer to traditional PC apps

logRetention.label: Log Retention
logRetention.desc: Auto-delete oldest logs when count exceeds limit (1-100)
logRetention.title: Max cleanup logs to retain

dataDir.cannotWrite: Current storage location is not writable. Please extract the portable package to a directory with write permissions.
dataDir.migrationDone: Legacy AppData migrated. Original data remains.
dataDir.changeDirDesc: Select a dedicated empty folder for cleanup logs and cache data. Config file will not be migrated.
dataDir.viewLogsDesc: View historical cleanup records and detailed file lists
dataDir.clearDataDesc: Selectively clear logs, backups, snapshots, history cache and virtual disk records
dataDir.migrateSuccessDesc: Original AppData data retained. Portable version now uses the program directory.

systemTools.startupDesc: Open Task Manager to disable unnecessary startup programs
systemTools.storageDesc: Open Windows built-in disk cleanup and space management

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: If you encounter a problem or have a suggestion, contact me through one of the channels below.

clearData.title: Clear local data
clearData.subtitle: Only the allowlisted data below is removed; app settings are kept.
clearData.warning: These items can be cleared safely without removing app settings. Disk change snapshots are separated by drive, so you can keep a drive's baseline. A cleared drive will rebuild its baseline on the next scan and show comparisons again after the following scan.
clearData.summary: {{count}} files will be removed; estimated space freed: {{size}}

installHistory.label: Installation history cache
installHistory.description: Used to improve uninstall-leftover detection. Deleting it makes the module relearn installation paths.
installHistory.warning: Safe to clear, but uninstall-leftover detection signals will be rebuilt.

logs.label: Cleanup logs
logs.description: Historical cleanup details used to review past operations.

registryBackups.label: Registry backups
registryBackups.description: Backup files created before context-menu and registry cleanup.
registryBackups.warning: Deleting them removes the ability to review past registry cleanup operations from these backups.

shellIconLogs.label: Virtual-drive operation log
shellIconLogs.description: Records virtual-drive removal, restoration and anti-recreation operations.

shellIconBackups.label: Virtual-drive registry backups
shellIconBackups.description: Registry and permission backups created before shell-icon cleanup; they can restore an entry.
shellIconBackups.warning: Deleting them prevents restoring removed virtual-drive entries from backup.

driverBackups.label: Driver backups
driverBackups.description: Driver-package backups exported before old-driver cleanup; they may be large.
driverBackups.warning: Deleting them prevents manual restoration of cleaned driver packages. Not selected by default.

diskGrowthSnapshot.label: {{drive}} disk-change snapshot
diskGrowthSnapshot.description: Baseline and shard details used for disk-change analysis on {{drive}}.
diskGrowthSnapshot.warning: Safe to clear. The next analysis of this drive will rebuild its baseline, and comparisons will return after the following scan.

bigFiles.title: Large file cleanup
bigFiles.scanLimitDesc: Controls the maximum number of files returned per scan. Higher values find more candidates but increase rendering and review cost.
bigFiles.range: Range: {{min}} - {{max}} items. Switching drives clears old results so files from different drives are not mixed.

hotspot.title: Large folder analysis
hotspot.depthDesc: Number of folder levels shown in results
hotspot.minSizeDesc: Folders below this size are excluded to reduce noise.
hotspot.ignoreSystem: Skip system folders in deep scans
hotspot.ignoreSystemDesc: Turn this off to find unusually large files in protected folders, at the cost of a much longer scan.
hotspot.autoIgnoredDesc: The following folders are skipped or protected during scans and will not appear as cleanup candidates:
hotspot.systemCore: C:\Windows — Core system folder; deleting it can crash Windows
hotspot.programFiles: Program Files / Program Files (x86) — Installed software; view only
hotspot.windowsComponents: WinSxS / System32 / SysWOW64 — Windows component storage
hotspot.appCache: DriverStore / WindowsApps / assembly — Driver and Store-app caches

diskGrowth.title: Disk change analysis
diskGrowth.maxEntriesDesc: Limits the number of folders returned after comparing with the previous snapshot. Higher values increase rendering and sorting cost; 300 or fewer is recommended.
diskGrowth.range: Range: 50 - 1000 items. The baseline list still appears on the first scan or when there are no changes.
diskGrowth.detailDesc: Click a change amount to open details. The left side shows child-folder changes and the right side shows changed files. Details are loaded on demand in pages of up to 200 items.
diskGrowth.snapshotDesc: Snapshots are isolated by drive and up to three sets are retained per drive. The newest two are used for comparisons and one extra set is kept for diagnostics.
diskGrowth.speedDesc: Speed mainly depends on file count, drive type, MFT size and real-time security scanning.
diskGrowth.mftWarmupDesc: The first MFT scan after launch may be slower while filesystem caches and security checks warm up.
diskGrowth.newColor: Blue: new since the previous snapshot
diskGrowth.growthColor: Red: significant growth of 1 GB or more
diskGrowth.fastColor: Orange: rapid growth of 300 MB or more
diskGrowth.minorColor: Yellow: minor growth of 1 B or more
diskGrowth.reducedColor: Green: smaller than the previous snapshot

diskInfo.title: Disk information
diskInfo.description: View physical disk details, volume space and Windows health reports.
diskInfo.healthNotice: Health status comes from Windows Storage and device reports, not a complete SMART test. Unknown does not mean healthy or faulty.
diskInfo.notRead: Disk information has not been read
diskInfo.notReadDesc: Click Read information in the upper-right corner to load physical disk data.
diskInfo.noneDesc: Read again later or check whether the Windows Storage service is available.

security.verifyFailedDesc: The current file does not match the official exe signature for this version.
security.networkDesc: Check your network and try again.
security.networkRetry: Check your network or run the integrity check later.
security.releaseDesc: This version can be verified after its Release is complete.
security.releaseCardTitle: No official signature asset has been published for this version
security.signatureDesc: The official signature file is malformed. Wait for the publisher to fix the release asset.
security.downloadDesc: Official LightC files are published only through the channels below; other sources are third-party mirrors.

guide.title: Feature guide

scan.title: Scan all
scan.desc: Scans common junk such as temporary files, browser caches and Windows update caches. Scanning never deletes files; choose items in the results.

bigFiles.title: Large file cleanup
bigFiles.desc: Choose a drive and scan its largest files. Check paths and types carefully before deleting system or important files.

diskInfo.title: Disk information
diskInfo.desc: Read-only view of physical disks, volumes and Windows health reports. Unknown does not mean healthy or faulty.

social.title: Social-app cleanup
social.desc: Detects common social-app caches and registry-defined custom locations. Chat databases are locked, transfer files need review, and image/video cache is usually safe.

systemSlim.title: System slimming
systemSlim.desc: Manages hibernation, Windows component storage and virtual memory. Administrator access is required; ResetBase affects update rollback.

drivers.title: Old driver cleanup
drivers.desc: Drivers in use cannot be selected. Packages are backed up before deletion and can be restored from the module header.

leftovers.title: Uninstall leftovers
leftovers.desc: Uses confidence signals to identify possible leftovers in AppData and ProgramData. Verify paths, sizes and usage before deleting.

registry.title: Registry redundancy
registry.desc: Scans orphaned values and invalid references. A backup is created before deletion.

contextMenu.title: Context-menu cleanup
contextMenu.desc: Finds context-menu entries pointing to missing executables. HKLM entries require administrator access and are backed up first.

hotspot.title: Large folder analysis
hotspot.desc: Analyzes AppData hotspots and large folders on a selected drive. Results locate space usage; protected folders are not cleanup candidates.

diskGrowth.title: Disk change analysis
diskGrowth.desc: Builds an MFT baseline per drive and compares new, reduced and significantly changed folders. It locates changes but does not offer one-click deletion.

shellIcons.title: Shell-icon cleanup
shellIcons.desc: Finds third-party virtual-drive entries in This PC. Cleanup removes only the Explorer entry, backs up the registry and does not delete cloud files.

aiModels.title: AI model space
aiModels.desc: Analyzes model assets from Ollama, LM Studio, ComfyUI and HuggingFace; enable deep discovery when needed.

guide.permissionsDesc: Administrator access reads NTFS MFT records and protected temporary locations. Path allowlists, system protection and file-lock checks still apply.
guide.securityDesc: Standard deletion skips folders containing executables. Deep cleanup applies protected-path allowlists, executable checks and reboot deletion fallback.

risk.safeDesc: Temporary, cache and log files that usually do not affect the system.
risk.lowDesc: Media and downloads; confirm that they are no longer needed.
risk.mediumDesc: Databases, documents and archives may contain important data.
risk.highDesc: Program and configuration files may affect software if deleted.
risk.criticalDesc: Core system files; deletion may prevent Windows from starting.

notes: Deletion cannot be undone; review files before cleaning.
System slimming changes system features; understand the impact first.
Deep cleanup permanently deletes files without using the Recycle Bin.
Registry cleanup creates a .reg backup before making changes.
guide.disclaimer: LightC provides scanning and deletion tools. Every deletion is confirmed by the user. The developer is not responsible for data loss, system failures or other damage caused by use of the software.
